Maria G: Quick heads-up — breadcrumbs on runtime guide point to a 404: https://redwood.infra/docs/runtime/kv-cache
Lina K: can you paste the markdown path + snippet?
Maria G: file: docs/runtime/kv-cache.md, around line 40
Maria G: snippet:
```
- [KV cache guide](/docs/runtime/kv-cache)
```
Samir: that's the old slug; current is /docs/runtime/kv-cache-overview
Lina K: @Samir can you own a tiny PR to swap the link + add frontmatter redirect?
Samir: yes — will run quick sed and open PR. sed I plan: `git grep -l "/docs/runtime/kv-cache" | xargs sed -i '' 's|/docs/runtime/kv-cache|/docs/runtime/kv-cache-overview|g'`
Tony C: fyi add a shortlink redirect so older external links don't 404
Lina K: @docs-bot please create a redirect ticket
docs-bot: Created DOCS-4827: redirect /docs/runtime/kv-cache -> /docs/runtime/kv-cache-overview (docs-ops)
Maria G: thanks, I'll smoke-test staging preview once PR is up
Samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/789 — changed link + added frontmatter redirect
Maria G: checked staging preview — breadcrumbs fixed :thumbsup:
Lina K: noted ownership in tracker (docs/runtime/kv-cache-overview -> Lina K)
Tony C: optional: add canonical on old slug, not blocking
Maria G: closing this thread, thanks all
